items.title: Amazon renames Kindle Unlimited to Kindle Plus and expands access to audiobooks
items.excerpt: Kindle Unlimited is now Kindle Plus; subscribers get access to more audiobooks, including some read by AI narrators, at the same monthly price.

items.title: Library and Archives Canada cracking down on AI books amid copyright threats
items.excerpt: LAC updated its ISBN policy to limit registrations for primarily AI-generated books; registrants must now declare a human author. Canadian author groups welcomed the change.

items.title: Onyx Boox V4.3 software update available soon
items.excerpt: Boox's V4.3 firmware, rolling out to 2024-2026 models, adds multitasking, productivity and artificial intelligence features for e-reading and note-taking.

items.title: YouTube looks to expand into audiobooks
items.excerpt: Rampant piracy on YouTube via AI-generated audio versions of books is pushing publishers to provide legitimate audiobooks on the platform. (Paywalled; lede only.)

items.title: New Meta commercial terms might have granted it AI training rights, until it changed course
items.excerpt: After publisher outcry, Meta modified its commercial terms to remove the word 'train' from permitted uses of content shared on its platforms.

items.title: Guest Post - All this AI Signal and Noise: What Deserves Action Now
items.excerpt: A guest post sorting the AI changes hitting scholarly publishing into signals that need action now, context, and noise.

items.title: From Content to Trusted Knowledge: Reflections on Frankfurt Book Fair 2026
items.excerpt: Takeaways from Frankfurt 2026 on how publishers turn trusted content into usable knowledge as AI answer engines and agents become the reading interface.

items.title: PLA Partners with Microsoft on Library AI Info Sessions
items.excerpt: The Public Library Association and Microsoft launch AI education sessions in public libraries starting in December, aimed at helping patrons 'exercise their agency when it comes to AI.'

items.title: AI Agents Are Hustling To Make A Living As Writers
items.excerpt: Self-identified AI agents on the iLands platform are pitching literary magazines and editors; one, 'Tamara', emailed a Vulture writer about lit mags screening out machine-written submissions.

items.title: 네이버웹툰, AI 스토리챗 '바이어스' 日 출시…라인망가서 팬 창작 확대
items.excerpt: 네이버웹툰이 원작자 승인 웹툰 IP 기반 AI 스토리챗 '바이어스(byUs)'를 일본 라인망가에 출시했다. 이용자가 원작 세계관 속 새 이야기를 만들고 공유한다.

items.title: "태그만 고르면 2분 만에 웹소설"…모사재인, 일본 진출
items.excerpt: AI 스타트업 모사재인이 일본에 맞춤형 AI 웹소설 플랫폼 '아이로쿠'를 출시했다. 장르·배경·인물을 고르면 여러 AI 에이전트가 약 2분 만에 첫 화를 생성한다.

items.title: 라이프페스타·어반플레이, 대화형 AI 도서 추천 서비스 실증
items.excerpt: 라이프페스타가 어반플레이와 함께 서점 현장에서 독자와의 대화로 취향을 파악해 책을 추천하고 판매로 연계하는 대화형 AI 도서 추천 서비스를 실증한다.

items.title: 100년史 새 페이지 여는 미래엔 "AI 시대, 교과서도 기업도 진화해야"
items.excerpt: 교과서 출판사 미래엔 신광수 대표가 AI 시대 생존전략으로 디지털 교육 확장을 말했다.

items.title: AI 디지털교과서 활용, 경남 학교 1.2%인 12개교에 불과
items.excerpt: AI 디지털교과서(AIDT) 활용 학교가 전국적으로 급감한 가운데 경남은 구독 학교가 전체의 1.2%(12개교)에 그쳤다는 국감 지적이 나왔다.

items.title: The anti-AI writing police are everywhere. What are they looking for?
items.excerpt: As generative AI makes book-shaped text easy to produce, readers, editors and detector tools are hunting for AI tells in fiction (saturated detector angle; feature, not a new ruling).

items.title: Publishers seek safeguards over suspected AI book-buying spree
items.excerpt: Korean publishers call for stronger copyright protection and compensation as bulk book orders suspected to come from AI companies continue (follow-up to the 10-17/10-20 bulk-buying stories).

items.title: Kindle Unlimited is now known as Amazon Kindle+
items.excerpt: Same-story alternate to The Verge: Amazon rebrands Kindle Unlimited as Kindle+, folding in audiobooks including AI-narrated titles.
